title: The Route Tree
narrativeQuestion: How did people the NFL never planned for find their way onto rosters, and what does Invincible change about Vince Papale's real route?

chapters.title: The Vet, 1976
chapters.claim: Papale was a pole vaulter with no college football and two WFL seasons who made the Eagles at 30 after an invited workout. Invincible cut the Bell and invented the walk in tryout.

namedPeople.name: Vince Papale
namedPeople.anchorNote: Character card slot. The teacher supplies the photo, listed in /storyhub/bts/route-tree/people/people.json. Real footage also plays in the embedded video.

chapters.title: The Odds
chapters.claim: Of 1,000 high school players about 73 play NCAA football and about 1 senior in 1,000 is drafted.

chapters.title: The Route Tree
chapters.claim: Ten routes into the NFL share a few doors: a walk in, a call, a tryout, another league, another sport, a cut, an injury, a program.

chapters.title: Night Train Lane
chapters.claim: An Army veteran walked into the Rams office in 1952 and set the 14 interception record.
